originals.evidence: Missing result: choice-free measurable gluing of countably many Lq classes, or an explicit choice premise. Read all five current proof steps, local density proof and exact prerequisites. Unique quotient classes do not choose representatives. Under AC, select representatives and glue on disjoint layers X_n minus earlier X_n; compatibility gives the local identities, MCT the finite-q bound, and countably many measurable bound failures the infinity bound, followed by Lp-continuity. The finite density supplier currently also assumes AC. Hunter Measure Theory sections 1.1 and 7.5, Theorem 7.14, pp.1,85-87 explicitly uses ambient AC and only sketches this extension, so supplies no choice-free gluing. Required owner decision: authorize a published AC-premise/disjoint-layer repair and carry the premise through actual consumers, or provide an independently proved choice-free replacement. Assigned consumers already assume AC and their applications are sound; the general published interface remains open.
